newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom issue history day in German finance-Waigel.
newsitem.headline: Telekom issue history day in German finance-Waigel.

text.p: German finance minister Theo Waigel, calling the Deutsche Telekom listing on Monday a landmark day in Germany's financial history, said the issue was a high point for privatisation in Germany.
The Telekom issue, the largest ever in Europe, would provide a decisive impulse for increased financial market activity and would help popularise stocks in general in Germany, he said.
Private German investors, unlike their counterparts in the U.S. and the U.K. have historically been wary of stock investments, preferring instead to put their savings in fixed income securities.
The finance minister's remarks were supported by Wolfgang Boetsch, postal minister, who said the stock listing was a milestone in the history of Deutsche Telekom.
